text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
"And the NHK Mile Cup begins once again this year!
Bringing together the classic division's fastest sprinters,
all eyes this year are, of course, on—"

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
"Participating from the Oka Sho for the first time in history,
Rhein Kraft and Daring Heart!
We bring you coverage from the pre-race press conference—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: First up, Line Craft! Tell us, how are you feeling about taking on this unprecedented, historic challenge?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah, y-yes...!
(*Snap... snap, click-click*)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—"Show the world the new possibilities of the Tiara."
Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Kh!
Yeah, I'm...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Not just the Triple Tiara—
I want to show everyone that Tiara Umamusume
have so much untapped potential!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's a wonderful goal!
So, what about you,
Daring Heart-san?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Unlike the glamorous Tiara route races, this race has long been a fierce battleground where speed-boasting champions clash.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: "I believe the atmosphere will be completely different from before, but... should we start by carefully waiting and seeing?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please.
Wait and see? As if I ever would!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I'll bravely take on
any challenge――Charging in bravely.
That's my best quality, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's true the atmosphere changes completely.
It's fierce, too. But—”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Then that's all the more reason it's okay, right?
We've always been like that—the two of us!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Second to no race!
Our battle is fiercer... and more beautiful
than anything anywhere else!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Craft.
Shall the two of us prove it to them?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That our passion burns hotter than anyone else's!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Was I... perhaps being a bit too provocative?

If it were the old me, I certainly would have broken out in a cold sweat in this situation.
But now... now that I've boldly faced challenges alongside her, I can say it openly.
choice_data_list: It's perfect for getting the crowd going.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. Aren't you
starting to take after me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We need to think calmly from here on.
The atmosphere will definitely be different from before.
choice_data_list: Be careful not to get swallowed up by the pack.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Right. There are a lot of physically strong girls out there... If you get boxed in, it's hard to break out.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything else I should watch out for?
Like, anything important not to forget?
choice_data_list: ...Maybe it's about having fun with all your heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, got it!
Please do the same yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Something even more thrilling than a Queen's dream...
I'll show it to you!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Heart-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for earlier at the press conference!
You ended up cheering me on again, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Just like back during the Hanshin JF.
My heart was... pounding a little.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Because when I stopped to think about it,
I realized what an incredible challenge I've taken on."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: But I'm okay now!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter what race it is!
We will run our own race—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Because you're here, I can do this!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...No, thank *you*.
Your words have fired me up even more.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Craft. Why do you think I'm here?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —I've been chasing after you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My heart was moved by the desire to run with you.
—More so than chasing my dream of becoming Queen.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Craft. Let's make this an even more magnificent race than the Oka Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let's clash even more fiercely!
So hot that even the Oaks' fever can't reach us!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“—Let our running
be the spark that ignites this era!”
